entities.name: EPS Authentication and Key Agreement
entities.description: Provides mutual authentication between the user and the network and agrees on key KASME. Initiated and controlled by the network, but UE can reject the authentication challenge.

entities.name: KASME
entities.description: Key derived from CK and IK, stored in EPS security contexts, and serves as root for EPS integrity protection and ciphering key hierarchy.

entities.name: CK
entities.description: Ciphering key computed by USIM during EPS authentication, used as key material to compute KASME.

entities.name: IK
entities.description: Integrity key computed by USIM during EPS authentication, used as key material to compute KASME.

entities.name: USIM present
entities.description: Condition that UE shall proceed with EPS authentication challenge only if a USIM is present.

entities.name: Partial native EPS security context
entities.description: Established in UE and network when EPS authentication is successfully performed.

relations.description: EPS AKA procedure results in agreement on KASME key.
EPS AKA procedure requires USIM to be present for UE to proceed.
Successful EPS authentication establishes partial native EPS security context.
